name: Union Market
demographics: Union Market serves the affluent Mission Viejo community in South Orange County, attracting primarily upper-middle-class families and professionals with household incomes exceeding $100,000. The trade area draws residents aged 25-54 with children, as well as active retirees who appreciate the upscale neighborhood shopping experience. Visitors typically seek convenient access to specialty food retailers and services within a walkable, open-air environment that complements the master-planned community's lifestyle preferences.
description: Union Market is a neighborhood-oriented shopping destination located in the heart of Mission Viejo's Crown Valley Parkway corridor. This community-focused center serves the surrounding residential areas with a curated mix of retailers and services designed for the daily needs of local families and professionals. The center operates daily from 11:00 AM to 11:00 PM, providing extended hours for the convenience of busy shoppers. With a strong 4.6-star rating, Union Market has established itself as a reliable shopping option within Mission Viejo's well-planned commercial landscape. The center's location along Crown Valley Parkway positions it within one of Orange County's most desirable master-planned communities, offering easy accessibility and ample parking for neighborhood residents.
summary: Union Market is a community shopping center serving Mission Viejo residents along Crown Valley Parkway. The center offers convenient daily shopping with extended hours and maintains a strong 4.6-star customer rating.
